description: Wait for an element to reach a certain state, a page load state, or a fixed timeout. Useful after navigation or clicks that trigger async content loading. Use loadState="networkidle" after posting on Twitter/X or after navigation to ensure all async requests have settled.

loadState.description: Page load state to wait for. Use "networkidle" after posting a tweet to confirm XHR requests settled. Takes priority over selector when provided.

selector.description: CSS selector to wait for. If omitted and loadState also omitted, waits for timeout.

sessionId.description: Browser session ID. If omitted, auto-selects the only open session.

state.description: Element state to wait for (default: "visible"). Only used with selector.

tabId.description: Target a specific tab within the session. Auto-resolved from environment if omitted.

timeout.description: Timeout in ms (default: 10000 for element waits, 15000 for loadState).

name: browser_wait
